method: Live GitHub REST API via gh api; no local checkout used. Commit count is the last page number with per_page=1 at a captured default-branch head. The oldest API entry is reported with its parent count; this is not a search over all branches. Contributor, release and tag endpoints are paginated to exhaustion. Contributors omit anonymous identities (GitHub default); account type User is not independent proof of a unique human. Subscriber count is subscribers_count, not watchers_count (which aliases stars). Counts are endpoint snapshots, not simultaneous or measures of users, deployments, downloads or book buyers.
